ratios.quote: Our actual interest coverage for the four consecutive quarters ended June 30, 2026 was 2.78 , which is above the minimum interest coverage of 2.00 .
Our actual maximum secured leverage ratio for the four consecutive quarters ended June 30, 2026 was 1.66 , which is below the newly established maximum secured leverage ratio of 3.50 .

parsed.notes: Under the April 2026 Amendment (Amendment No. 6), the maximum leverage ratio (debt to adjusted earnings) was not tested for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. It is not tested in the first three quarters of 2026, then rises to 6.75 through December 31, 2027, and steps down to 3.75 by March 31, 2029. The minimum interest coverage was lowered to 2.00 through June 30, 2027 and steps up to 3.50 by March 31, 2029. The secured leverage covenant is newly established at 3.50 maximum. Covenant terms apply to FMC and its consolidated subsidiaries. The Senior Secured Notes covenants are excluded.
